title: Validate JOB-CI-001 cron delivery model against OpenClaw 2026.3.11 breaking change
summary: OpenClaw 2026.3.11 removed agent-send from isolated cron jobs. JOB-CI-001 execution profile may be affected. Needs validation and profile update if broken.
body: Jobs Review (2026-03-16) flagged that JOB-CI-001 cron delivery model may be affected by OpenClaw 2026.3.11 breaking change: isolated cron jobs can no longer perform ad-hoc agent sends. Validation required: (1) check if JOB-CI-001 uses isolated-cron agent-sends; (2) if yes, apply fix (announce delivery with channel/webhook output); (3) run smoke test; (4) update cron post-update smoke checklist to include cron delivery validation.
requested_action: Validate and update JOB-CI-001 cron delivery model for OpenClaw 2026.3.11 compliance; run smoke test; update checklist.
proposed_action: Validate and update JOB-CI-001 cron delivery model for OpenClaw 2026.3.11 compliance; run smoke test; update checklist.
